verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a built-in agent that takes delegated work. It builds segments from plain-text descriptions via "Describe segment", analyzes the workspace, runs recurring scheduled tasks (Daily Routines such as deliverability reports and segment audits), and accepts work from inside Slack threads. These first-party claims cover the core of the story, though they come mostly as short llms.txt snippets. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the in-app assistant's scope and how delegation works, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-product agent.
